headline: CSU Pueblo and Regis open a gap at the top
dek: Regis won at Fort Lewis, third in the table, for their tenth win of the season, and have not lost since UCCS beat them early in October. CSU Pueblo, the one side above them, remain unbeaten and go to UCCS next.
displaced_by: Regis won at Fort Lewis; the standing dek's ninth win, level goals conceded with CSU Pueblo and trip to Fort Lewis are no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 28; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo are the last unbeaten side in the conference after UCCS lost at Colorado Mesa.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and fourteen defeats, the latest at UCCS.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 48.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's Nick Cenek has eleven goals and four assists this season, from 53 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 63 saves this season and conceded 15 goals.

last_match.line: Since conference play opened, Fort Lewis have lost only to CSU Pueblo, UCCS and Regis; Regis have not lost since UCCS beat them.

next_match.line: CSU Pueblo have yet to lose this season; UCCS are the last side to have beaten Regis.
